hangar.meta.v1.Condition.description: Condition is one observed aspect of an object's state, such as "Ready".

observedGeneration.description: The generation this condition was computed from.

reason.description: CamelCase machine-readable cause of the last transition.

status.description: ConditionStatus is the state of a condition.

hangar.meta.v1.ObjectMeta.description: ObjectMeta is the metadata every resource carries. Users set name, project, labels and annotations; everything else is owned by the system. See docs/decisions/apply-semantics.md.

annotations.description: Keys under a *.hangarlab.cloud/ prefix are reserved for the system.

deleteTime.description: Set when deletion was requested and finalizers are still pending.

generation.description: Incremented on every change to spec.

labels.description: Keys under a *.hangarlab.cloud/ prefix are reserved for the system.

name.description: DNS-1123 label, unique within the project (or the platform, for global kinds). An Invitation's is an email instead.

resourceVersion.description: Store revision of the last write to this object.

hangar.meta.v1.OwnerReference.description: OwnerReference points at the object that owns this one. An owner is in the same project, a global object, or, for a global object, one in the project the reference names; when it is deleted, its dependents are garbage collected.

controller.description: The owner is the controller responsible for this object.

project.description: The owner's project, when the owner is project-scoped and this object is global, as a RoleBinding owned by the ServiceToken it names. Empty otherwise.

hangar.storage.v1alpha1.CustomImageDiskS.description: CustomImageDiskSource names the Disk an image is captured from.

name.description: Names a Disk in the image's project.

hangar.storage.v1alpha1.CustomImageSourc.description: CustomImageSource is what an image is captured from.

disk.description:
A Disk in the image's project, captured as it is when the image is made. The disk must have been made on a node, and every machine it is attached to must be stopped; until the image is snapshotted, none of them can start and no machine can attach it.

Set at most one of disk.

hangar.storage.v1alpha1.CustomImageSpec.description: CustomImageSpec says where an image comes from and what it is.

defaultUser.description: The user the image's cloud-init makes, such as "ubuntu", whom hangar ssh logs in as unless told another; empty, it must be told.

minDiskSize.description: The smallest disk made from it, a quantity such as "10Gi"; empty is the image's own size, status.disk_size.

os.description: What the image holds, for people choosing one, such as "ubuntu" and "24.04".

source.description: What the image is captured from; it cannot change once the image is made.

hangar.storage.v1alpha1.CustomImageStatu.description: CustomImageStatus is what the apiserver and the image's node found. The apiserver writes node and disk_size as the image is made; the node writes the conditions and used_size.

diskSize.description: The source disk's size, in whole Gi: the smallest disk made from the image.

node.description: Names the Node the image lives on: its source disk's. Disks made from the image are made there.

usedSize.description: What the image holds, rounded up to whole Gi, once it is Ready: what it counts toward the disk quota. Until then it counts as disk_size.

description: CustomImage is a disk image of a project's own, captured from one of its Disks, such as a stopped VM's root disk, that the project's disks are then made from as they are from an Image. It is an independent copy: the source disk can be started, changed or deleted once the image is snapshotted. The platform does not change what it holds; run "cloud-init clean --machine-id" in the guest before stopping it, so each VM made from the image is a new instance. See docs/decisions/custom-images.md.
title: CustomImage
